Hi Oliver — great to hear and thanks for the PO.

Short version: we can be flexible for pilots but need a few controls for credit risk and VAT. Proposed structure that should meet both teams in practice:

- Invoice A (setup + month 1): 30% of total, due Net7 upon invoice receipt (this covers onboarding effort and reserved capacity).
- Invoice B (go-live milestone): 50% of total, due Net45 from invoice date (we can accept Net45 here in lieu of Net60).
- Invoice C (remaining subscription pro-rate): 20% of total, due Net30 after final acceptance.

Credit cap: we can provision an interim credit line of up to $200,000 for the pilot period once we have: 1) signed SOW, 2) purchase order (you sent PO stub — thanks), and 3) VAT registration or confirmation that MedicoRE will apply reverse charge on your side. If MedicoRE requires a $250k ceiling, we will need a card-on-file or an approved credit application (our Finance team can fast-track if you share last 2 quarters AR aging).

VAT: Redwood can provide our VAT registration certificate and can issue reverse-charge compliant invoices where applicable — I’ll attach the certificate once I have approval from Finance (cc Kimberly).

Next steps: I’ll loop in Finance for a quick credit check/approval and send a DocuSign SOW link. If you’re ok with the staged invoicing above we’ll prepare the SOW today.
